	svc        SVC

}

func NewMetricsService(svc SVC, errCounter *prometheus.CounterVec) *MetricsService {

		svc:        svc,
		errCounter: errCounter,

}

// WidgetVersion gets the widget version
func (s *MetricsService) WidgetVersion(ctx context.Context) ([]byte, error) {
	resp, err := s.svc.WidgetVersion(ctx)

}
